text:
deploybot: [PROD] Deploy pipeline paused for tag v2.7.1-rc3 — pre-merge checks failing (3/8 checks failed, 2 timeouts). Blocked by required checks: integration-tests, e2e-regression.

jessica: ugh. Is this a flaky spike or real break? https://ci.internal/runs/12345

sam: looking. integration-tests are timing out on db-connection step, several runners reporting queue saturation.

ci-bot: Failed jobs: integration-tests (timeout 00:30), e2e-regression (flaky 5/12), lint (ok). Logs: https://ci.internal/build/12345

mike: We have a change window in 25m. Do we want to pin to v2.7.0 and continue, or wait for rerun?

anita: I'd prefer pin. Rerun currently queued behind high-priority jobs, might take >30m.

sam: I can promote the rerun to priority. `/ci rerun --job integration-tests --priority`

sam: done. promoted, CI says estimated start ~2m.

deploybot: Note: deploy is on hold until required checks pass. Manual override available: `/deploy override --force --reason "emergency"` (ops approval required).

ops-oncall: please don't force unless rollback impossible. If v2.7.0 is clean, pin and schedule a hotfix later.

mike: pinging @release-manager to sign off on pin (we need change log update). @jessica can you draft release note delta?

jessica: on it. will prepare short note and patch changelog.

ci-bot: Rerun started: integration-tests #12346. Estimated finish 00:12.

sam: fresh run passed unit-tests but one e2e still flaky. integration-tests now passing.

ci-bot: e2e-regression still failing on Firefox matrix (3/4). Flake rate 25%.

anita: that's risky for prod. recommend pin to v2.7.0 and reschedule v2.7.1-rc3 for next window.

mike: agreed. @deploybot can we pin the deploy to commit 'v2.7.0' and cancel current job? `/deploy pin v2.7.0`

deploybot: Action queued: pin to v2.7.0. To confirm reply `confirm pin` within 5m.

mike: confirm pin

deploybot: Pin confirmed. Deploy target set to v2.7.0. Cancelling RC pipeline. Notifying release channel. :white_check_mark:

jessica: will update release notes and post revert plan.

ops-oncall: moving this to change-window follow-up. Thanks all.

mike: closing thread once release notes are up.
